# TCalc

TCalc is an open-source, local-first workspace token calculator, coding-model recommender, and agent-context optimizer.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://tcalc-one.vercel.app/
- Documentation: https://tcalc-one.vercel.app/docs/
- Getting started: https://tcalc-one.vercel.app/docs/getting-started/
- CLI workflows: https://tcalc-one.vercel.app/docs/cli-workflows/
- Model catalog: https://tcalc-one.vercel.app/docs/model-catalog/
- Coding-agent MCP: https://tcalc-one.vercel.app/docs/coding-agent-mcp/
- Team reports: https://tcalc-one.vercel.app/docs/team-reports/
- Source: https://github.com/Sandesh13fr/TCalc

## Product facts

- TCalc scans source locally and does not upload workspace code.
- The bundled catalog contains 20 models across seven catalog providers and nine provider endpoints.
- It produces token estimates, three recommendation tiers, repo maps, agent rules, and Markdown or JSON reports.
- The core product is free under the MIT License.
